So Y4S2 would have CS4212, CS3219, CS4222. 4+4+4=12 MC. Plus ATAP? No, ATAP is Y4S1. So Y4S2 has 12 MC. This is fine. Now, CS3233. Ideally before CS2105. And CS4212 before CS3233 (soft). If CS4212 is Y4S2, CS3233 must be after Y4S2 to satisfy soft wish? No, "CS4212 before CS3233" means Sem(CS4212) < Sem(CS3233). If CS4212 is Sem 8, CS3233 must be Sem > 8. Impossible. So this soft wish cannot be met. That's fine. CS3233 can be taken in Y3S2 (Sem 6). CS2105 can be taken in Y3S1 (Sem 5). Then CS3233 (Sem 6) is after CS2105 (Sem 5). This violates "CS3233 before CS2105". Can we take CS3233 in Y2S2? Y2S2 is Sem 4. CS2105 in Y3S1 (Sem 5). Then CS3233 (Sem 4) is before CS2105 (Sem 5). This satisfies the soft wish.
